description: Move a domain to another Nymwell workspace (it stays at the registrar). action "list" (incoming and outgoing); "request" with domain and to_email (an owner or admin there accepts within 5 days; possible 10 days after registration); "accept" or "decline" an incoming move (id) sent to the person you act for; "cancel" an outgoing one (id).
name: domain_moves
title: Move a domain between workspaces
